item.title: New Iranian Consul General in Basra meets FM Araghchi
item.description: Mostafa Tarfī, the newly appointed Consul General of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Basra, met with Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi prior to his departure for his new post and presented a report on his area of responsibility and the existing capacities, along with his proposed plan. During the meeting, the Foreign Minister, referring to the very good relations between the Islamic Republic of Iran and Iraq as two neighboring and Muslim countries, stressed the need to further deepen bilateral relations in the political, economic, social and cultural spheres and to make optimal use of Iraq’s capacities, given the many commonalities between the two countries.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.mfa.gov.ir/portal/newsview/793707

Mostafa Tarfī, the newly appointed Consul General of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Basra, met with Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi prior to his departure for his new post and presented a report on his area of responsibility and the existing capacities, along with his proposed plan. During the meeting, the Foreign Minister, referring to the very good relations between the Islamic Republic of Iran and Iraq as two neighboring and Muslim countries, stressed the need to further deepen bilateral relations in the political, economic, social and cultural spheres and to make optimal use of Iraq’s capacities, given the many commonalities between the two countries.

item.title: New Iranian Consul General in Kazan meets FM Araghchi
item.description: Mohammad Basraei, the newly appointed Consul General of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Kazan, Russia, met with Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi prior to his departure for his new post and presented his proposed plan for advancing affairs in his new position. The Foreign Minister wished the new Iranian Consul General in Kazan success and, referring to the importance of relations between the Islamic Republic of Iran and Russia, stressed the need to work toward strengthening relations with the Republic of Tatarstan and other republics and regions in Russia’s Volga area in all fields of mutual interest, particularly in the economic, tourism, academic and consular sectors. Prior to his appointment as Iran’s Consul General in Kazan, Basraei served as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ treasurer and Director General for Financial Affairs.

Original source: https://en.mfa.gov.ir/portal/newsview/793705

Bassem Naim, a member of the Political Bureau and head of the Arab and Islamic Relations Office of the Palestinian Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas, who has traveled to Tehran for consultations with Iranian officials, met with Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi on Wednesday afternoon. During the meeting, Naim conveyed warm greetings from Khalil al-Hayya, the newly appointed head of Hamas’ Political Bureau, to Araghchi. He also reiterated the condolences of Hamas leaders and the Palestinian people over the martyrdom of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Imam Khamenei, as well as a number of Iranian commanders, figures and citizens. He paid tribute to Iran’s martyred leader for his role in defending the sacred cause of the liberation of Palestine and Al-Quds. The Hamas Political Bureau member also briefed Araghchi on the latest developments in Palestine, including the continued “brutal crimes” by the Israeli regime in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank, the Judaization of Al-Quds, and the brutal torture of Palestinians in prisons run by the occupying regime. Naim said the approach of the Israeli regime’s “criminal prime minister” was to continue fomenting war, committing genocide against Palestinians and forcibly displacing the Palestinian people by maintaining the inhumane policy of imposing a blockade and preventing humanitarian aid from entering the Gaza Strip. He called for serious and immediate action by the international community, particularly Islamic countries, to confront Israeli aggression and crimes against the Palestinian people and support the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination. Araghchi, for his part, thanked Hamas leadership for sending messages of condolence and sympathy and expressing solidarity with the Islamic Republic and the Iranian people. He stressed Iran’s principled and firm position on continuing comprehensive defense of the country against aggressors, as well as supporting the sacred cause of the liberation of Palestine and the establishment of an independent Palestinian state with Al-Quds as its capital. The Iranian foreign minister also stressed that the Islamic Republic would continue its efforts to support the legitimate rights of the Palestinian people in international forums, including meetings of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization and BRICS, as well as the upcoming session of the United Nations General Assembly.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemns the aggressive actions taken by the United States against our beloved homeland on Tuesday night, September 1, and reaffirms the Islamic Republic of Iran’s determination to firmly defend Iran’s independence, national sovereignty, and territorial integrity. The US regime, having been driven to desperation in the face of the Iranian people’s ironclad resolve to defend the country, once again violated Iran’s national sovereignty and territorial integrity on Tuesday night, September 1, 2026, by attacking several civilian areas and service infrastructure, including a number of telecommunications towers and sites in the provinces of Khuzestan, Sistan and Baluchestan, Hormozgan, and Kerman. As a result, a number of our compatriots were martyred or wounded, and damage was inflicted on public and private property. In the attack by the American enemy on a wedding celebration in Kuhestak, located in Sirik County, Hormozgan Province, more than 70 of our compatriots were martyred or wounded, most of them women and children. These brutal war crimes, which constitute a flagrant violation of the fundamental principles of international law, are reminiscent of previous American-Zionist crimes over the past year and a half, including those in Minab and Lamerd. In response to the US military aggression, the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran, pursuant to their inherent right of self-defense, launched defensive and devastating strikes against US military bases that had served as the launching points for and provided support to the US military aggression against Iran. The Islamic Republic of Iran strongly calls on the countries of the region to prevent the continuation and expansion of the flames of war in the region by denying the American aggressors the use of their facilities and territory to prepare for and carry out acts of aggression against Iran, and not to allow the sinister US-Zionist plot to impose permanent insecurity on the region to be realized. While expressing its condolences over the martyrdom of our dear compatriots, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs reminds all governments of their responsibility to pursue, prosecute, and punish the perpetrators and those who ordered grave violations of international humanitarian law. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs once again reminds the United Nations, particularly the Security Council and the UN Secretary-General, of their responsibility to fulfill their duties in accordance with the UN Charter. The silence and inaction of the organs of the United Nations in the face of the continued violation of the fundamental principles and rules of the Charter, particularly Article 2(4), by a permanent member of the Security Council will further undermine the credibility of the Organization and pose an increasing threat to international peace and security.

In response to this military aggression and in accordance with its inherent right of self-defense, the powerful armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran carried out forceful and devastating defensive strikes against US military bases located in Jordan, which served as the launchpad for and provided support to the US military aggression against Iran. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemns the US military aggression against Lark Island, which constitutes an explicit violation of Article 2(4) of the Charter of the United Nations, and reminds the UN Security Council and the Secretary-General personally of their responsibility to fulfill their duties to safeguard international peace and security and hold the aggressor accountable. The Islamic Republic of Iran reminds the UN Secretary-General, the President of the Security Council, and all governments that have expressed their concern over the continued insecurity in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz that the sole factor responsible for making the region’s shipping routes unsafe has been the illegal and aggressive actions of the United States and the Israeli regime. These actions began with the attack on Iran on February 28 and have continued in various forms over the past six months, including a naval blockade and other provocative and interventionist measures. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs emphasizes that the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran will not hesitate to exercise their inherent right of self-defense and will decisively respond, as appropriate, to any military aggression by the enemy. It is self-evident that full responsibility for the consequences of the United States’ new acts of aggression, as well as the continuation of the naval blockade and economic war against Iran, rests with the US regime and all parties that, in any way, collude or participate in the preparation and implementation of the United States’ illegal and unlawful actions.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.mfa.gov.ir/portal/newsview/793451

Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi attended an interactive session with participants of the 40th International Islamic Unity Conference, held in the presence of Hojjatoleslam Hamid Shahriari, Secretary General of the World Forum for Proximity of Islamic Schools of Thought, as well as scholars and thinkers from Iran and other countries. Addressing regional and international developments, Araghchi described the issue of Palestine as the most important concern of the Muslim world and stressed the need to strengthen Islamic unity to thwart the conspiracies of the Israeli regime and its main supporter, the United States. “Our approach to the Muslim world is based on strengthening unity among the Islamic Ummah,” the Iranian foreign minister said. “This approach is the legacy of Imam Khomeini and our martyred leader, and today, under the guidance of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, we are all determined to continue along the same path.” Describing developments in the region over the past two years, including the US-Israeli wars imposed on Iran, Araghchi said the martyrdom of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution after 70 years of struggle for Iran’s independence and dignity had established a new starting point and foundation for continuing the path of seeking justice and exercising strength. “Undoubtedly, avenging the blood of our martyred leader, in continuation of the movement of Karbala, will remain a lasting demand of the Iranian nation and all Muslims and freedom-seekers around the world,” he said. Araghchi said the Islamic Republic of Iran, which he described as a “blessed tree,” had grown into a strong and mighty tree thanks to the blood of martyrs, the steadfastness of the discerning Iranian people and the courage of the country’s powerful armed forces, adding that its strength and dignity would continue to increase. Referring to the consequences of the US-Israeli military aggression for the region, the foreign minister said one of the most important outcomes of the war was that everyone realized the US military presence in regional countries does not provide security for them. “The only objective of the United States in the region is to support the illegitimate and expansionist ambitions of the genocidal Zionist regime,” he said. Araghchi said this growing understanding, which amounts to losing hope in the United States, could pave the way for the emergence of endogenous security based on trust and cooperation among regional countries. He also highlighted the Islamic Republic’s commitment to the interests of the Islamic Ummah, particularly the Resistance Front, saying Iran had spared no effort at any stage to help promote unity in the Muslim world in confronting the Israeli regime’s occupation, ending the genocide against Palestinians, and putting an end to Israel’s aggression and occupation of Lebanon. The foreign minister stressed that Iran firmly believes security and stability in West Asia require an end to the Israeli regime’s impunity and the realization of the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination, with Al-Quds as its capital. He added that the Islamic Republic’s proposed plan in this regard was clear. Araghchi described strengthening national self-confidence and demonstrating the value and importance of independence and self-reliance as among the most important legacies of the Islamic Revolution. He said these factors had contributed to advancing a diplomacy based on dignity, emphasizing that Iran’s diplomatic apparatus would continue working with full force to safeguard the country’s national interests based on the three principles of “dignity, wisdom and expediency,” and would under no circumstances show leniency toward excessive demands or bullying. During the session, Araghchi thanked Muslim scholars and thinkers from various countries for attending the International Islamic Unity Conference and responded to questions and proposals raised by some participants.He also stressed Iran’s principled approach to developing good relations with all Islamic countries, particularly neighboring states, saying Tehran sought the best possible relations with its neighbors in all fields, including economic and scientific cooperation. He said strengthening relations among Muslim countries was essential to enhancing the position of the Muslim world globally and improving the situation of Muslims in all parts of the world. “I believe that God has destined the path of unity and solidarity for Islamic countries,” Araghchi said, adding that care must be taken to ensure that differences do not allow enemies to exploit them to sow division among the Islamic Ummah. At the end of the meeting, the foreign minister thanked Hamid Shahriari and the World Forum for Proximity of Islamic Schools of Thought for organizing the session and for their efforts to strengthen Islamic unity. Shahriari, for his part, thanked the Foreign Ministry for its cooperation in organizing the 40th Islamic Unity Conference, as well as the foreign minister and Iran’s diplomatic apparatus for their continued efforts to promote rapprochement and unity across the Muslim world.
